title: decline_reason free text has no server-side bound — unauthenticated POST stores unbounded text into result JSONB
evidence:
server/src/reference_checks/form_handler.gleam:926-930
  let reason = application_handler.get_form_value(values, "decline_reason")
  let note = case reason {
    "" -> option.None
    text -> option.Some(text)
  }
server/src/reference_checks/form_pages.gleam:447
            attribute("maxlength", "200"),
server/src/reference_checks/result.gleam:95
    Some(text) -> [#("decline_reason", json.string(text))]
server/src/application/application_handler.gleam:1553-1555 (the /apply precedent the new route skips)
      let personal_statement =
        values
        |> get_form_value("personal_statement")
        |> truncate(2000)
detail: The only length cap on the reason is the client-side maxlength="200" attribute; a crafted POST bypasses it. The value is persisted verbatim (json.string escapes JSON but not size) into reference_call.result JSONB, bounded only by the 10MB middleware body gate (middleware.gleam:34 const max_body_size = 10_485_760). The /apply path truncates identical free text to 2000 graphemes (truncate at application_handler.gleam:2284); decline has no equivalent. Not re-rendered in this diff (static confirm page), but the text rides the compliance-relevant result store that RC4's landlord panel and DSAR exports will consume.
recommended_fix: Server-side bound the reason before persisting: reject or truncate to 200 graphemes (mirror the truncate() pattern used on /apply free text) in apply_decline.

title: Art 21 evidence insert is not atomic with the objected transition — an insert failure permanently loses the evidence row
evidence:
server/src/reference_checks/form_handler.gleam:1070-1081
        Ok(pog.Returned(_, [_, ..])) -> {
          // The transition happened — write the Art 21 evidence (once).
          insert_objection_evidence(
            config.db,
            config.sentry,
            id_uuid,
            app_uuid,
            row.ref_slot,
            channel,
            payload_ref,
          )
server/src/reference_checks/form_handler.gleam:1126-1131
    Error(err) -> {
      wisp.log_error(
        "reference objection: evidence log failed: " <> string.inspect(err),
      )
      sentry_client.capture(
detail: The terminalize UPDATE commits first (autocommit; no transaction), then the evidence insert runs best-effort. If the insert fails, the row is already objected and every later tap hits the 0-row branch (form_handler.gleam:1083 Ok(pog.Returned(_, [])) -> wisp.redirect) — the insert is never retried, so the Art 21 evidence row is permanently absent for that objection. Documented as best-effort, but the evidence is the DPC-compliance trail.
recommended_fix: Wrap the guarded UPDATE + evidence insert in a single pog transaction, or on insert failure retry once before giving up.

title: parse_focus_seconds accepts negative and unbounded client values, stored verbatim into fraud_signals
detail: Gleam int.parse accepts a leading minus, so _focus_seconds=-7 (or any 64-bit value) is stored as focus_seconds_reported in the result's fraud_signals.form_session block with no floor/ceiling. The field is client-reported fraud input that rc3-7 builds on; negative or absurd values poison the signal and the stored evidence record.
recommended_fix: Clamp the parsed value (e.g. 0..=86400, or None/0 when out of range) before it reaches StructureContext.
